tool_description: Get basic information from 28k+ airports and landing strips around the world. With filtering, sorting and pagination options.
name: AirportsData
title: AirportsData

api_list.name: Get airports
api_list.description: Will return data from 28k+ airports in the database.

optional_parameters.name: lid
optional_parameters.description: U.S. FAA Location Identifier (12,566 entries), or an empty string

optional_parameters.name: sortBy
optional_parameters.description: Sort results by a property value. Possible values are: IATA, IACO, name, city, subd, country, tz, lid and elevation.

optional_parameters.name: name
optional_parameters.description: Filter results by name. The value should be sent as comma-separated.  For example, for *Zabrat Airport*, send *Zabrat,Airport*

optional_parameters.name: elevationOver
optional_parameters.description: Filter airports with an MSL elevation, or highest point of the landing area in feet, over this value.

optional_parameters.name: country
optional_parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (plus XK for Kosovo).

optional_parameters.name: city
optional_parameters.description: Filter results by city. The value should be sent as comma-separated.  For example, for *Zakynthos Island*, send *Zakynthos,Island*

optional_parameters.name: sortByOrder
optional_parameters.description: Specify the sorting order. Possible values are *asc* and *desc*. Results are sorted in ascending order by default.

optional_parameters.name: elevationUnder
optional_parameters.description: Filter airports with an MSL elevation, or highest point of the landing area in feet, under this value.

optional_parameters.name: tz
optional_parameters.description: Timezone expressed as a tz database name (IANA-compliant) or an empty string for Antarctica.

optional_parameters.name: subd
optional_parameters.description: Filter results by subdivision (e.g. state, province, region, etc.). The value should be sent as comma-separated.  For example, for *Newfoundland and Labrador*, send *Newfoundland,and,Labrador*
